text.tspan: The listing is checked a second time here, because the
first check is already stale by the time the buyer confirms.
The re-check and the state change happen as one unit, so a
second buyer confirming at the same moment finds it
Reserved and takes the lower branch (ext 5a).
The order stands. A failed notice is never a
reason to roll back a reservation.
No Order is created and the listing keeps the status
it already had. This is the UC-05 minimal guarantee.

svg.text: Approved, Available, buyer is not the seller
seller has 24 hours, cancel any time before handover,
refused. Status is Reserved, Sold, Removed or Pending Approval
explain, refresh the listing, offer approved
